name: Tree Ring Width Measurement
description:
Perform dendrochronological analysis on a tree cross-section. 

1. Open the 'Tree Rings' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Tree Rings (48K)).
2. Draw a straight line radially from the center outward across the rings.
3. Generate an intensity profile (Analyze > Plot Profile) to visualize the ring boundaries (peaks/valleys).
4. Measure the width (in pixels) of at least 5 consecutive growth rings. You can do this by measuring distances between peaks/valleys in the profile or by measuring segments on the image.
5. Save a table containing the individual ring widths and a summary (Mean, Min, Max) to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/tree_ring_measurements.csv'.
